title: 업무 양식 편집
expectedVisibleState: 업무 양식의 수동 입력값 controls만 보이고 가짜 필드를 만들지 않는다.
loadingState: storage write 중 해당 input만 disabled.
emptyState: 필수 입력값이 없으면 최소 상태만 표시한다.
errorState: 일반 저장 성공/오류 문구를 shell status에 띄우지 않는다.
statusPolicy: Form value persistence feedback must not use shell status text.
hiddenSurfacePolicy: Catalog-owned product surface rows remain visible and reachable regardless of backing data availability; component-local filtering must not hide 구조.md surfaces.

backendContract.failureEvidence: schema/storage failure remains failure evidence without success copy

fixedShellContract: 400px Chrome side panel width, fixed full-opacity header, one central surface, fixed footer. Header, first content row, and footer top keep stable app-shell-relative coordinates across Chrome tab/window state.
motionContract: Work surface enters through data-view-motion contract.
overflowContract: Input rows fit inside central surface without footer overlap.

verticalAnchoringInvariant.coordinateSpace: Actual Google Chrome side panel .app-shell coordinate space, not an extension URL tab viewport.
requiredMeasurements: non-fullscreen problem-state real Chrome side panel capture
fullscreen normal-state real Chrome side panel capture
tab-switch or side-panel-reopen real Chrome side panel capture
.root-panel or first primary control bounding rect
failureSignals: same surface card top changes across Chrome tab/window state
same surface menu block top changes across Chrome tab/window state
extension URL tab viewport evidence is used as release proof without real side-panel evidence
fullscreen-only evidence is used as release proof for the non-fullscreen side-panel failure

prohibitedPlaceholders: sample guest, room, branch, reservation, amount, or hotel value
success text without a successful owner boundary
